name: Advenis SA
summary: Advenis SA produces, distributes, and manages real estate and financial assets to institutional and private clients in France. The company also manages real estate mutual funds. In addition, it provides wealth management and distribution services; and real estate services, such as asset and property management, facility management, and brokerage and advisory services. The company was formerly known as Avenir Finance SA and changed its name to Advenis SA in July 2015. Advenis SA was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Paris, France.
